findings.problem: With no verb in the prompt, nothing makes the case accusative, and "Ein Kaffee, bitte" (nominative) is also often heard when people order in Germany, so a learner could fairly give ein Kaffee instead of einen Kaffee.
findings.fix: hint: the object of an unspoken ich möchte (I'd like)

back.target: a coffee (accusative, as the object of a verb such as möchte or hätte)
back.example: I would like a coffee, please.

note: The Spanish card cafe-coffee has the same noun, but a case card's sameAs stays null, so null is right here.
